## Scenario

Use `gg_edit()` when the figure needs multiple natural-language revisions while
remaining an inspectable `ggplot` session.

This case exercises figure edits such as legend placement, title, labels, and
session history.

```{r base-session}
car_data <- transform(mtcars, cylinders = factor(cyl), car = rownames(mtcars))

base_plot <- ggplot(car_data, aes(wt, mpg, colour = cylinders)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = "Weight", y = "Miles per gallon", colour = "Cylinders") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

offline_session <- start_ggai_session(base_plot)
offline_session
plot(offline_session)
```

## Offline reference

This reference mimics the target result of a multi-turn edit.

```{r offline-reference}
label_row <- car_data[which.min(car_data$mpg), ]

p_reference <- base_plot +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel efficiency vs weight",
    subtitle = "Reference output for a multi-turn editing session"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = label_row$wt,
    y = label_row$mpg,
    label = label_row$car,
    hjust = 1.05,
    size = 3,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "#374151",
    label.size = 0.25
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_reference
```

## Live ggai case

```{r live-editing, eval=params$run_live}
s <- ggai(
  "@car_data show fuel efficiency vs weight, color by cylinders. Keep it as an editable session."
)

s <- gg_edit(s, "move legend to bottom")
s <- gg_edit(s, "set title to Fuel efficiency vs weight")
s <- gg_edit(s, "label the car with the lowest miles per gallon")

plot(s)
spec_history(s)
session_context(s)
as_code(s)
```

## Expected checks

```{r checks}
stopifnot(inherits(offline_session, "ggai_session"))
stopifnot(inherits(p_reference, "ggplot"))
if (run_live) {
  stopifnot(inherits(s, "ggai_session"))
}
```
